title: There is No Arguing Against This
description:
Democrats are threatening a filibuster over the SAVE Act: legislation that simply requires proof of citizenship and photo ID to vote in federal elections.

So here’s the question no one on the Left can answer: why?

Polling shows overwhelming support for voter ID across the board, Republicans, Democrats, independents, and every racial group.
